sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Remove the non-applicable partition constraints that are not stated by the requirement. The current sh:or incorrectly requires every PC1–PC5 ship to have bulbousBowPresent=true, so a PC1–PC5 ship without a bulbous bow fails even though the rule is inapplicable; the BulbousBowAbsentShape also imposes an unnecessary polarClass class check. Encode the applicability boundary so only ships with polarClass PC6 or PC7 and bulbousBowPresent=true receive the force, operand, unit, and formula checks, while all other ships are permitted without invented constraints. Preserve the existing DIRECT_CALCULATION formula, 1000 MegaN-to-KiloN conversion, expected-value-scaled piecewise tolerances, and not-less-than comparisons.
